data.explanation: This is a confirmation of your new gym membership (Mitgliedschaft). It starts on 1 March 2026 and runs for a minimum of 12 months at €34.90 per month, collected monthly in advance by direct debit (Lastschrift). To end it at the end of the minimum term, you must give 1 month's notice. After that it runs indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with 1 month's notice. You can cancel through the cancellation button in the app or by e-mail. The app calculates your cancellation deadline from these terms. Make sure your bank account has enough funds for the debits.
